POSTGRES_USER.name: POSTGRES_USER
POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL superuser username. Referenced by pelican as ${{pelican-db.POSTGRES_USER}}.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL superuser password. Auto-generated at deploy time. Referenced by pelican as ${{pelican-db.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}.

POSTGRES_DB.name: POSTGRES_DB
POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database name. Pelican uses this database for all its data.

POSTGRES_PORT.name: POSTGRES_PORT
POSTGRES_PORT.description: Port PostgreSQL listens on inside the container. Must stay 5432.

PGDATA.name: PGDATA
PGDATA.description: Data directory inside the volume. Points below the mount root to avoid the lost+found conflict.

REDIS_AUTH.name: REDIS_AUTH
REDIS_AUTH.description: Redis password (requirepass). Auto-generated at deploy time. Referenced by pelican as ${{pelican-redis.REDIS_AUTH}}.

REDIS_PORT.name: REDIS_PORT
REDIS_PORT.description: Redis server listening port. Referenced by pelican as ${{pelican-redis.REDIS_PORT}}.

REDIS_HOST.name: REDIS_HOST
REDIS_HOST.description: Redis internal hostname. Referenced by pelican as ${{pelican-redis.REDIS_HOST}}.

APP_URL.name: APP_URL
APP_URL.description: Public URL for the panel (Railway auto-generates this)

APP_DEBUG.name: APP_DEBUG
APP_DEBUG.description: Enable debug mode (do not enable in production)

BEHIND_PROXY.name: BEHIND_PROXY
BEHIND_PROXY.description: Set true if behind a reverse proxy (Railway)

TRUSTED_PROXIES.name: TRUSTED_PROXIES
TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Comma-separated trusted proxy IPs (* for all)

DB_HOST.name: DB_HOST
DB_HOST.description: PostgreSQL hostname. Auto-resolved to pelican-db service private domain.

DB_PORT.name: DB_PORT
DB_PORT.description: PostgreSQL port. Auto-resolved from pelican-db service.

DB_DATABASE.name: DB_DATABASE
DB_DATABASE.description: Database name. Auto-resolved from pelican-db service.

DB_USERNAME.name: DB_USERNAME
DB_USERNAME.description: Database username. Auto-resolved from pelican-db service.

DB_PASSWORD.name: DB_PASSWORD
DB_PASSWORD.description: Database password. Auto-resolved from pelican-db service.

REDIS_HOST.name: REDIS_HOST
REDIS_HOST.description: Redis hostname. Auto-resolved to pelican-redis service private domain.

REDIS_PORT.name: REDIS_PORT
REDIS_PORT.description: Redis port. Auto-resolved from pelican-redis service.

SKIP_CADDY.name: SKIP_CADDY
SKIP_CADDY.description: Skip Caddy web server (for PHP-FPM only setups)
